title: Hold Yo-wr Horses
description:
Hey thair, bud.  Ya found yourself a hoss, eh? well, let this ole fella teach ya what 'e knows.  Maah nuh-ame? oh, ah don't gawt one, jus' cahwl me a trayveler.
In any case, hooaah don't ya gitty-up ahead an tame that one.  Jus' gawt ta raahd it until it loves ya. Ah'll give ya a saddle afterwards.
